notes.title: Some Minor Fixes and Updates
notes.notes:
- Updated the Start Zones to only activate when 2 or more players are present.
- Fixed Softlock that caused infinite loading screens when the host would exit the game with more than 2 players, while loaded into a level.
- Changed how Sacred Blocks work to prevent Ghosts from getting stuck.
- Made a tweak to Up and Down with the rotation of floating objects.

Thank you, Rombo :)

notes.title: Added some basic Achievements
notes.notes:
Added an achievement for beating the game.
Added an achievement for collecting all the fruit.

Achievements will unlock when returning back to the main lobby.
